summary: Wave C3 close-out testing. Backend tagline PT confirmed via public URL. Admin login works. Sitemap.xml serves PT canonical URLs with hreflang=pt-PT. _redirects file served correctly. All 6 hardcoded string changes verified in PT on public URL (SiteTracking, Situations, Invoices, Comparatif, TechAnalysis). CRITICAL: All 5 client-side FR->PT redirects (/investisseurs, /calculateurs, /prix, /estimation, /fonctionnalites) are BROKEN - URL does not change and FR page renders because of duplicate/earlier route registration in App.js.

ui_bugs.issue: FR->PT client-side redirects do not fire. Lines 149-165 register FR paths (/investisseurs, /fonctionnalites, /estimation, /calculateurs, /prix) pointing to real components (Investors, Features, Estimator, Calculators, PriceSearch). Lines 235-244 later define <Navigate to=PT/> for the SAME paths, but React Router matches the first registered Route, so redirects never execute. Verified in browser: navigating each FR URL keeps URL unchanged and renders the FR page.

issues: Substantial French leftovers still visible on this page: heading 'ConstruPilot face aux logiciels BTP du marché', 'Fonctionnalité' column header, 'Notre solution', 'Sur devis', 'Gratuit', 'Ver les tarifs', 'Essayer gratuitement'. Only the specific 'Suivi de chantier' string was fixed.

Heavy FR leftovers on suppliers tab: 'Editar le fournisseur', 'Adicionar un fournisseur', 'Agence', 'Téléphone', 'Adresse de livraison', 'Ligne', 'désignation / mot-clé', tab names 'Ferraillage/Acier', 'Étanchéité', 'Toiture', 'VRD/Réseaux', 'Commandes', 'Mes fournisseurs'. Only the target 'Catálogo de preços' label is PT.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix App.js route order/duplication for FR->PT redirects. Either (a) remove the FR Route definitions at lines 149,152,160,162,165 (Investors, Features, Estimator, Calculators, PriceSearch) so the Navigate redirects at L235-244 take effect, or (b) move the Navigate redirect Routes above those component Routes. Currently the first matching Route wins so /investisseurs, /fonctionnalites, /calculateurs, /prix, /estimation all serve the FR component and never redirect.
(Optional/next wave) Additional FR leftover strings remain on /comparatif and /appro pages – out of Wave C3 scope but visible to users.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate Route paths in App.js is a bug pattern: react-router silently uses the first match. Consider consolidating FR aliases into a single lookup or removing legacy FR Routes entirely once PT paths are canonical.
TechAnalysis.jsx and Comparatif.jsx still contain many FR string literals; targeted single-line changes leave mixed-language UI (e.g. 'Editar le fournisseur' mixes PT+FR).

success_rate.frontend: 64% (7/11 features pass; 5 redirects fail counted as 1 blocker + 6 string changes pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: After E1 fixes App.js route ordering, re-verify each of /investisseurs, /investors, /calculateurs, /calculators, /prix, /prices, /estimation, /fonctionnalites, /inscription, /reinitialiser redirects to the PT counterpart via browser navigation (curl won't work since redirects are client-side unless underlying host honors _redirects). Other Wave C3 items already verified PT.
rca of the issue: React Router evaluates Routes in registration order and picks the first match. App.js registers <Route path='/investisseurs' element={<Investors/>}> at L149 before <Route path='/investisseurs' element={<Navigate to='/investidores'/>}> at L235. The first Route wins so the Navigate is unreachable. Same duplication for /calculateurs, /prix, /estimation, /fonctionnalites. Mitigation: delete the legacy FR component routes or move the Navigate redirects above them.
